issues.title: Egypt, Somalia coordinate return of eight Egyptian sailors released after kidnapping
issues.title_en: Egypt, Somalia coordinate return of eight Egyptian sailors released after kidnapping
issues.summary: Somali Ambassador to Egypt Ali Abdi Awari said that coordination between Egyptian and Somali authorities is underway to complete arrangements for the return of eight Egyptian sailors who were recently released after being kidnapped off the coast of Somalia.
